Furthermore, profitability is highly strained with a razor-thin gross margin of 11%, a low operating margin of 2% (446M), and a net loss of -4M. While a current ratio of 1.18 provides some short-term liquidity, the combination of negligible equity capitalization, unprofitable operations, and massive liabilities places this issuer in the highly speculative category.

DECISION: B-
